headline: Iron Ore Prices Fall on Shrinking Chinese Steel Margins and Softening Demand
summary: Dalian iron ore futures fell 0.69% to 651.5 yuan per ton while Singapore futures slid to $88.25, weighed down by falling steelmaker profit margins and weak Chinese steel demand.
why: Iron ore is the principal raw material for steelmaking, heavily tied to Chinese property construction and industrial output.

impacts.name: Iron Ore
impacts.why: Persistently weak steel manufacturing margins in China reduced raw material demand.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Declining profit margins at Chinese steel mills forced lower bids for raw iron ore.
